assertions.name: route5_theta_reproduces_from_the_retired_z_eq_1_cell
assertions.source: theta = acos(Q_beta^exp / (Q_A*(1-u^2))) with Q_A the z=1 cell gives 0.0566173007941, reproducing route 5's printed 0.056617301 to rel 8.389e-17. So the ellipticity target's base is MEASURED to be the z = 1 cell, not inferred from prose. R(z=1) = 0.99839766871926 < 1.

assertions.name: on_both_ruled_bases_R_exceeds_one_so_elliptic_is_excluded
assertions.source: R(z_D) = 1.75936462427 and R(dashboard) = 1.20024943393, both > 1. An elliptic generator has character cos(theta) <= 1 (Real.cos_le_one -- the SAME invariant the carrier file's replacement_excludes_some_matrix already uses), so on the ruled base no elliptic generator can supply the correction: acos(R) is not real. This is the exact MIRROR of step 18, which excluded real spectrum because cosh a >= 1 > 0.998399.

assertions.name: the_direction_is_base_dependent_not_uniform
assertions.source: R lands on BOTH sides of 1 across the four bases: z=1 0.9983976687 and augmentation 0.8891903171 are below, z_D 1.759364624 and the dashboard cell 1.200249434 are above. So 'route 5 needs an elliptic generator' is not a fact about the framework -- it is a fact about which admissible functional is the base, and that was invisible while only the z=1 cell was in view. NOT a reason to prefer a base: per AGENTS.md NO FITTING a base is never chosen by which obstruction it removes.

assertions.name: ruled_base_asks_for_a_REAL_spectrum_generator_and_names_its_value
assertions.source: with R > 1 the equation cosh(a) = R HAS a real solution, so the class step 18 excluded is the class the ruled base requires: a = 1.16530530037 on z_D and a = 0.622738411685 on the dashboard cell. Steps 19 (Im q) and 20 (the |q| = 1 fibre locus, theta/2pi rational, N = 111) are downstream of the OPPOSITE requirement and do not arise on the ruled base at all.

assertions.name: prose_theta_is_the_convention_C_form_value_not_the_live_target
assertions.source: three Lean files and two beans carry 'theta = 0.0565947' for this quantity; the live producer computes 0.05661730079406103, a relative 0.000399185 away. That gap IS the documented form-vs-experiment correction (route 5's own docstring: 'moved it by 4.0e-4'), and the bean records 0.0565947 as |alpha_N1| in convention C to 7 digits. So the prose figure is the convention-C FORM value. Live sites, all in commit 87bf883793 -- the SAME commit whose probe corrects the target: EigenphaseCarrierVacuity.lean:221, BringEllipticCurveJInvariant.lean:39, nuclear-interactions/q-beta-cos-resummation.lean:191. NOT swept: on the ruled base theta does not exist at all (check 2), so these would need re-deriving rather than re-numbering, and AGENTS.md's 2026-09-07 ask-first directive governs. Recorded, not fixed. This probe's own first draft took 0.0565947 from that prose as an input and failed its own check -- which is how the discrepancy was found.

assertions.name: kohno_drinfeld_own_value_still_misses_on_every_base
assertions.source: KD fixes hbar = 2 ln q by matching the Hecke pair, giving character cosh(ln q_0) = (q_0 + 1/q_0)/2 = 1.00544843335. Against R that is 0.706208 % on z=1, -42.8516 % on z_D and -16.23 % on the dashboard cell. So the ruled base does NOT resurrect Kohno-Drinfeld: it moves the failure from a CLASS exclusion (wrong side of 1) to a MAGNITUDE gap (right side, wrong size), which is a weaker obstruction and a different problem.

description: Route 5's ellipticity requirement is computed from the RETIRED z = 1 cell. Reproduced here: theta = acos(Q_beta^exp/(Q_A(1-u^2))) with Q_A = m_e|q^2-2q-1|(q+1)/(2q^3) gives route 5's printed 0.05659469. The owner retired that cell as the base on 2026-09-08; the three step-18/19/20 files are dated 2026-09-07, so they were correct when written. On BOTH ruled bases the required factor R = Q_beta^exp/(base(1-u^2)) EXCEEDS 1, and an elliptic generator has character cos(theta) <= 1 -- so the requirement inverts: the ruled base excludes the elliptic class and requires the real-spectrum class step 18 excluded. Steps 19 (Im q) and 20 (the |q|=1 fibre locus, theta/2pi rational, N=111) are downstream of the opposite requirement. The direction is NOT uniform -- the augmentation base keeps R < 1 -- so it is a fact about the base, not about the framework, and is explicitly NOT a reason to prefer a base. Kohno-Drinfeld's own cosh(ln q_0) = 1.00545 still misses on every base, so the failure moves from a class exclusion to a magnitude gap.
retired_base_ruling: owner 2026-09-08: eps = Markov trace at z_D = q^3/(q^2+1); z = 1 retired as base
supersedes_nothing: steps 18-20 are NOT retracted: their algebra is exact and correct for the target they were given. What changed is the target.
invariants_cited: Real.cos_le_one (elliptic character <= 1) -- Mathlib, and already used by QOU.QBeta.EigenphaseCarrier.replacement_excludes_some_matrix
scope: (b) for the two class statements, each citing a proved invariant; (a) for every number. Derives no alpha, selects no base, proposes no wiring, and does not show that no connection exists.
